hero.title: EmbeddedFlow for exact embedded UI
hero.lead: Beyond static design tools — bind UI to code symbols, and soon to MQTT and protocols. Free for personal use.

features.title: More than a UI painter
features.lead: EmbeddedFlow connects design intent to real systems — not just exportable screens.
features.f1Body: Pro unlocks binding interface elements to symbols in your codebase.
features.f2Body: MQTT and other protocol bindings for live UI objects are on the Pro roadmap.
features.f3Body: Activate a license key in VS Code, Eclipse, or Visual Studio — one user, one device.

pricing.title: Simple plans
pricing.lead: One seat. One device. Upgrade when you need symbol binding and support.

download.lead: Install EmbeddedFlow where you already work.
download.hint: Free works without signup. Pro activates with your license key.
